Shortcodes

Every BRG shortcode and its attributes. Generated from kit/registry.json, which is the source of truth — each component carries a version and a contract hash of its attribute surface, so a doc generated from v1 can never quietly be v2's markup. Place these in an Oxygen Shortcode element or a WP Shortcode block, never a Text element.

[brg_nav]v1 · e4a3ae5fc13b

WordPress-menu-driven nav (fixed). Content from Appearance → Menus.

attributedefaultwhat it does
layoutleftcenter = logo centered; compact = logo-left, overflow → More drawer.
left2Items per side (split/center) or total-before-overflow (compact).
right2Items on the right side (split/center).
stickypinpin stays; hide = hide-on-scroll-down (nav is fixed, so it always sticks).
bgsolidsolid (white bar, reserves space) · none (transparent, floats over hero) · frost (dark frosted glass + blur).
bgcolor#fffBackground color for solid/frost, any CSS color (bgcolor="#131210").
opacity1Background opacity 0–1 (solid/frost).
ttl120Server cache seconds.
